settings.title: Settings
settings.panicHint: Three taps of Escape within half a second always stops the engine.
settings.generalDesc: How the app behaves on Windows: language, startup and what closing the window does.
settings.languageDesc: Interface language. Your saved macros are not affected.
settings.startWithWindowsDesc: FlowMacro launches when Windows starts. It only opens the app — it never runs a macro on its own.
settings.startMinimizedDesc: The app opens straight to the system tray without showing its window.
settings.minimizeToTrayDesc: With this on, the window's X hides the app in the tray instead of quitting it. Either way, X stops a running macro. To quit for good, right-click the tray icon → Exit.
settings.showTrayNotificationsDesc: A short tray notification when a macro starts and when it finishes.
settings.confirmBeforeDeleteDesc: Deleting a macro or a profile asks for confirmation first.
settings.appearanceDesc: How the app looks. None of this changes what a macro does.
settings.themeDesc: “System” follows the Windows light/dark setting and updates when you change it.
settings.hotkeysDesc: These shortcuts are system-wide: they fire whatever app you are in, with FlowMacro in the background or its window closed.
settings.hotkeyRepeatNote: Holding a shortcut down counts as one press — Windows key repeat no longer toggles the macro on and off.
settings.performanceDesc: How much work the interface does drawing itself. Turning it down cuts FlowMacro's own CPU and GPU use on a slow machine, or while you are in a game.
settings.animationQualityDesc: How long page transitions, menus and click animations take.
settings.quality_high: Animations play at full length. Smoothest look, most drawing work.
settings.quality_balanced: Animations run 20% shorter. The default: still fluid, less work.
settings.quality_low: Animations are switched off entirely; everything snaps. Lowest CPU and GPU use.
settings.performanceNote: This setting only touches the interface. The macro engine runs on its own thread — whatever you pick here, your click rate (CPS) and timing accuracy stay the same.
settings.dataDesc: Where your data lives and how much of it is kept.
settings.historyLimitDesc: The History page keeps at most this many entries; older ones are dropped. A higher number uses more disk. (50–5000)
settings.updatesDesc: FlowMacro downloads and installs new versions from GitHub.
settings.autoUpdateCheckDesc: Quietly looks for a newer version while the app starts.
settings.updatePortableNote: Update packages are signed and only install if they carry this project’s key. If you run the portable build, updating moves you to the installed build.

hotkey.press: Press a key or a mouse side button
hotkey.startDesc: Runs the selected macro, or the one you ran most recently.
hotkey.stopDesc: Stops the macro that is running.
hotkey.pauseDesc: Pauses a running macro; press again to carry on where it left off.
hotkey.emergencyDesc: Stops the engine at once, no matter what. The key for when something goes wrong.

onboarding.title: Welcome to FlowMacro
onboarding.body: Build a macro, give it a shortcut, and it runs wherever you are — games, forms, anything that takes input.
onboarding.pointOne: F6 starts, F7 stops, F8 pauses. Change them in Settings.
onboarding.pointTwo: Record what you do, then edit it step by step.
onboarding.pointThree: Tap Escape three times fast to stop everything, always.
